Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 24

“One who finds happiness within, delight within, and light within — that yogin, having become Brahman, attains the peace of Brahman.”

Three interior sources named in a row, ending with light. Krishna describes self-sufficiency not as isolation but as illumination that needs nothing outside itself to shine.
